verdict.rationale: Termius explicitly states that it lets you connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN, with infrastructure stored and encrypted locally (termius-docs-15). It is a native client speaking SSH, Mosh, Telnet and Serial (termius-docs-35), and community users describe reaching their own servers directly from mobile and desktop. Missing for 10: in-depth technical docs on the connection path (the no-relay claim is marketing-page only) and independent hands-on verification that no traffic goes through Termius infrastructure.
